business_summary: The Kyoto Hotel, Ltd. operates accommodation, banquet, restaurant, and other facilities in Japan. It operates hotels under the Karasuma Kyoto Hotel and Kyoto Hotel Okura names. The company also provides accommodation, banquet, restaurant, and ancillary hotel services. In addition, it offers guest rooms, banquet halls for events and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions), restaurants, bars, parking, fitness club memberships, and provides food and beverage sales. The Kyoto Hotel, Ltd. was founded in 1888 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
